description: Fires when column 6 (rightmost) is full and its top cell holds an opponent stone, strongest right after the opponent has just topped off column 6. It is boosted when column 2 is still low (3 or fewer stones) and columns 4 and 5 are (nearly) full, and weaker if the cell below the top is mine. If my stone tops column 6 it is near zero, except weak firing when the cell below is theirs.
effect: Small. In most positions steering changes move probabilities by under 5 points; when column 6 still has one empty cell, forcing it high lowers column 6 by about 12 points (acts like 'column 6 closed'); in one top position zeroing it moved about 23 points away from column 4.
notes: Layer 1. Key minimal pair: in a game, activation alternates with parity after column 6 fills (5.3, -0.1, 3.1, 0.9, 4.3...), i.e. depends on who owns the top cell of column 6. All 300 sampled firing positions had column 6 full. Dev F1: top-cell-theirs alone 0.61 (R .88); with bonuses (last move col 6, col 2 <=3, cols 4/5 >=5) 0.705; final weighted version 0.701, AUROC .925, sim share 0.51. Bonuses are coarse; exact strength depends on stone ownership lower in column 6. Synthesis reaches 6.11 > dev max 6.0. Synthesis replaced after orchestrator audit: the original sequences passed through a completed four (game would have ended); new ones were checked so no move completes a four for either side (6.014, 6.012, 5.936, 5.721, 5.659).
